messages:
Maya (People Ops): All-hands in 30m. Thread for last-minute role call, recording targets, and Q triage. Green room at 14:10.
Ivy (Producer): Bringing switcher + spare laptop. I'll run captions overlay and cue pre-roll. If YouTube lags we'll flip to internal-only stream.
Noah (Eng-Platform): Reminder: presenters close slack windows before screen-share. I'll shadow the screen-share session.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): If OBS CPU spikes, switch to NVENC and drop canvas to 720p. Quick kill snippet: `pkill -f ffmpeg || true` then restart recording.
Priya (Product): Can we move "Billing updates" after "Roadmap"? Prefer roadmap first so Qs are fresher.
Maya (People Ops): Swapped in deck. Ivy, can you confirm cue timestamps?
Ivy (Producer): Pre-roll at T-0. Demo cue at T+8. Qs start T+28. Will post manual two-minute warnings in thread.
Sam (CEO): I'll watch this thread + the questions doc. Ask leadership Qs here, product-specific Qs in the doc.
CaptionBot: Captions online \u2014 latency 1.9s \u2014 confidence 0.89.
DeployBot: Recording started \u2705 writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1798000123/session.mp4
Noah (Eng-Platform): Backup plan: local SSD recording -> S3 sync -> public publish. Rsync snippet after show: `rsync -av /mnt/ssd/all-hands-1798000123.mp4 gs://redwood-recordings/`
Ethan (Eng-SRE): If we lose ingest but local still recording, DO NOT stop OBS. We'll pull the file after.
Priya (Product): Post-meeting ask: product will collect top 5 roadmap questions and assign owners within 48h.
Maya (People Ops): Legal reminder: mark slides with customer data as "CUSTOMER CONTENT" and send to legal-review@redwood.ai.
Ivy (Producer): If I flip to internal stream I'll post `:warning: internal-only fallback active` with timestamp.
Maya (People Ops): Final call: need any presenter swaps?
Priya (Product): All good.
Sam (CEO): Thanks team. Keep slides tight so we have full Q window.
Maya (People Ops): Closing thread  follow-up notes + action items will be posted to #all-hands within 2 hours. Good luck! :sparkles:
